inventory_metadata.classification_source: nvidia-a51 Slurm allocation and fabric metadata captured before any Phase62 transfer: `scontrol show topology` InfiniBand leaf/core tree plus per-node Slurm feature tags at 2026-08-24T08:11:32+00:00, and per-GPU HCA PCIe proximity from `nvidia-smi topo -m`. rack_id is the node's InfiniBand leaf switch, network_domain is the core switch above that leaf. Hosts Phase60 measured were excluded from the allocation by asset name before any transfer. No measured timing and no Phase61 prediction or error was consulted.
inventory_metadata.created_by: GPU environment agent (Claude Code) on the nvidia-a51 Slurm allocation
inventory_metadata.fabric_notes: nvidia-a51 B200 cluster, NDR InfiniBand three-level tree (root a51 -> ibccore* -> ibcleaf*). L1 replicas keep all four endpoint slots inside one host (prenyx0214 and prenyx0265) and still transfer over Mooncake RDMA. L2 replicas stay inside a single leaf switch (ibcleaf01-02: prenyx0214+prenyx0215; ibcleaf01-04: prenyx0265+prenyx0266). L3 replicas cross from ibcleaf01-02 to ibcleaf01-04 through core ibccore01. The two replicas of each level use disjoint hosts. Every host here is absent from the frozen Phase60 plan, so all 24 Phase62 endpoint tuples and all six host signatures are new. Each host exposes 8x NVIDIA B200 and RDMA NICs ['mlx5_10', 'mlx5_13', 'mlx5_14', 'mlx5_15', 'mlx5_4', 'mlx5_7', 'mlx5_8', 'mlx5_9']; each endpoint uses the HCA with the closest PCIe proximity to its GPU.
